mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.5% compresses risk-free discount rates, reducing equity valuation multiples and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as capital flows toward risk assets.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% in a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger equity sell-offs due to reduced consumer spending confidence, producing negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods where UNRATE > 9.5% (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDP growth decline (GDPC1 annualized < 0.5%) and industrial production contraction (INDPRO monthly change < 0.0%) indicate economic weakening that reduces corporate earnings expectations, causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 annualized < 0.5% and INDPRO monthly change < 0.0%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL annualized > 3.0%) combined with low policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and generating negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained non-farm payrolls growth (PAYEMS monthly increase > 0.5%) indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods where PAYEMS growth > 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 650,000 units (HOUST < 650.0) in a 3-month average signals housing sector weakness that reduces consumer confidence and triggers negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods where HOUST < 650.0 (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent housing starts decline (HOUST < 650.0) and retail sales weakness (RSAFS < 350,000 million) indicate broad consumer demand contraction that reduces equity risk appetite, causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL annualized < 1.0%) indicates stable price environment where the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative policy, supporting equity valuations and generating positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL annualized < 1.0% (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).
